prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1220; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can reference the claim file.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Pasadena, Texas. I was backing out of a parking space near the main entrance.

Q: What happened next?
A: I was looking over my right shoulder, going slowly, and a pickup truck came down the lane and hit the rear passenger side of my car. It wasn't going very fast, but the impact jolted me forward and back.

Q: Did you hit the brakes before the impact?
A: Yes, I stopped right away when I heard the horn. I didn't have time to do much else.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any injuries right after the collision?
A: Not at first. I felt a little stiff, but I thought I'd be fine. By that evening my neck was really sore and I had a headache that wouldn't go away.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other medical provider since then?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next morning. They diagnosed me with whiplash and gave me a neck brace and some medication. I've also been doing physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement?
A: Yes. Turning my head to the right is hard, and I get stiffness when I sit at a desk for long periods. Some days are better than others.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'd appreciate a timely response on the repair estimate for my vehicle.

Q: Thank you. That concludes this statement.
A: Thank you.
